temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan initially deflects but then admits he has been keeping something from Christian: he is in some trouble and did not know how to tell him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is hiding something important from Christian, making him anxious and suspicious.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Confirmed: Jonathan was indeed hiding something important; specifically, he is in trouble.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan is in trouble and has been concealing it from Christian.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Anxious, suspicious, then concerned and shocked
temporal_state_chain.intention: Confront Jonathan to uncover the truth and learn more about what is going on.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan says the situation is complicated and he does not want to drag Christian into it, but eventually admits he could use support and resources and needs to find a way out.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is in trouble and has been hiding it from Christian.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Updated: Jonathan's trouble is complicated, and he needs help, support, and resources.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan needs Christian's support and resources to get out of a complicated mess.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Offer help and support, and help Jonathan face the trouble together.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan says he cannot say for sure whether it is illegal; he might have gotten involved with the wrong people, but he did not do anything illegal himself. He trusts Christian to handle it carefully.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is in complicated trouble and needs help; Christian now suspects or believes the trouble may be related to criminal activity.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Partially confirmed but still uncertain: Jonathan may be entangled with dangerous or criminal people, though he denies doing anything illegal.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan may be involved with the wrong people and is at risk, but he may not be guilty of a crime.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Investigate the matter discreetly without alarming Jonathan and ensure his safety.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian's investigation reveals that Jonathan is being framed; someone is trying to set him up. Christian has leads but not yet the full identity of the person responsible.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan may be entangled with dangerous or criminal people, and Christian is investigating discreetly.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: Jonathan is not the guilty party; he is being framed by someone.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan is innocent and is being framed; someone is trying to set him up.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Gather more evidence to prove Jonathan's innocence and clear his name.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian tells Jonathan he has found out who is behind this: someone close to both of them and trusted. Jonathan warns that this person is dangerous.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is being framed by an unknown person; Christian is gathering evidence to prove his innocence.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Identified: the real culprit behind the framing is someone close to both Christian and Jonathan.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Someone close to both of them has betrayed them and is responsible for Jonathan's framing.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Confront the real culprit and bring them to justice, while being careful because they are dangerous.
